verdict.rationale: Jules runs in its own VM, where it clones code, installs dependencies and modifies files, and one hands-on user reports it is good at making tests for isolated functions. This shows it generates tests, but the evidence never says it runs those tests to validate its changes before proposing a PR. missing for 10: documented automatic test execution, a self-validation loop before the diff/PR is proposed, first-party docs on test generation, broader corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them

citations.quote: is good at making tests for very specific/isolated functions
Jules runs in a virtual machine where it clones your code, installs dependencies, and modifies files.
